provenance.method: Steam developer/publisher listing checked on 2026-09-02. The record distinguishes mission mode, which has objectives and day planning, from the developer-described sandbox mode focused on creativity without objective stress.

name: Minami Lane
description: A single-player street-building management game with objective-driven missions and a separate sandbox mode described as creativity-focused and without mission-objective stress.
intended_use: Inspect when a player wants a choice between light management objectives and a less goal-driven sandbox mode.
audience_or_context: General-audience players comparing modes and pressure characteristics; the presence of a sandbox mode does not make every part of the game low-pressure.
limitations: Mission mode requires daily planning, management and completing objectives and may create time or optimisation pressure.
Sandbox mode and mission mode should not be conflated in discovery results.
The current record does not establish detailed accessibility settings or alternative-input support.
cost_or_access_notes: Commercial game distributed through Steam; price and platform availability can change.
conflicts_of_interest: The Steam listing is developer/publisher-supplied commercial information; ND Oracle records the mode distinction rather than adopting the product's 'cozy' positioning as an outcome claim.
